name: PIRSAPAAAD Whitening Beauty Cream
headline: Visibly Fair, Younger, Radiant Skin In 7 Days
shortDescription: Flagship 80g unisex skincare formula for intense brightening, dark-spot reduction, and even tone.
description: PIRSAPAAAD Whitening Beauty Cream is engineered with clinical-grade active botanicals and brightening agents. Tailored specifically for both women and men, this luxurious formula targets melanin hyperpigmentation, uneven skin tone, acne marks, and dullness. Noticeable luminous results guaranteed within our signature 7-Day Challenge.
benefits: Promotes visible glow & fair complexion in 7 days
Fades stubborn blemishes, dark spots, and discoloration
Protects skin barrier against environmental pollution
Formulated for all Indian skin types (Oily, Dry & Combination)
howToUse:
1. Cleanse face with lukewarm water and pat dry with a soft towel.
2. Scoop a small amount of PIRSAPAAAD cream on fingertips.
3. Gently massage in upward circular motions across face and neck.
4. Use consistently every morning and night for 7 consecutive days for peak results.
